answer: Operator-liability escrow.** Each agent action posts micro-collateral from the operator’s bonded pool, tagged to an operator ID that persists across wallets. Duplicate agents detected via behavioral fingerprinting (timing, tool-call cadence) trigger a tide of escrow slashing against the operator, not the clone. Clean operators recover collateral at epoch’s end; a sybil farm loses the island of shared collateral fast. Legitimate agents must keep a mesa of reserve above a sliding threshold — dupes erode it immediately, costing attackers their whole pool within one detection cycle.
